founding.title: Come as you are.
paragraphs: At FLAWLESS FADES 225, the chair is a place to pause. Whether you are settling into your usual style or ready to try something different, it begins with a conversation.
Bring your ideas, your reference photo, or simply yourself. A fresh look should feel personal — something you can make your own long after you leave the chair.

standard.title: A good cut.
paragraphs: Style is personal. The way you part it, the length you like, the finish you choose — small details that add up to a look that feels right.
Some visits are about keeping a favorite look. Others are the start of something new. Wherever you are headed, make a little time for yourself along the way.
